lines: We had done the gate attendants dirty, but in any case, we had been able to get into the school.
All that was left was to sneak into the classroom... However, the atmosphere inside the school was different from usual.
What's happening? There's some kind of commotion.
The first bell had finished ringing a long time ago, but there were still quite a few students in the hallway.
Aieeee, d-don't tell me there's another rebellion...!?
Not sure, but it doesn't seem like it. Shikanosuke-chan, you're getting scared too easily.
I stopped and asked a student who was carrying a box of something.
What is it? Oh, Fuma. The classes are getting rearranged.
Because of you Fumas and your rebellion, there's a lot fewer teachers and students. That's the reason. For cryin' out loud, don't talk to me.
He basically spat his answer at me and hurriedly left.
I had been on so many missions lately that I was completely out of touch with the school schedule.
Fuma, they really hate you, huh!
It's not like I'm the one who started the rebellion though.
Asagi-sensei also said that. But what can you do, not everyone knows all the details.
Oh, but I don't care about what's going on with you, Fuma. Not at all. Not even a little.
Fuma-chan! Just looked at the posted class list. All the same class.
Hebiko, Fuma-chan, Shikanosuke-chan, and also Yukikaze-chan.
Yes. And the homeroom teacher, though only temporarily it seems... is, ahaha, Sakura-sensei.
With the recent incident, it looks like Sakura-sensei has set her eyes on Hebiko, Fuma-chan and Shikanosuke-chan.
Uwuh, I've got nothing but bad feelings about this.
The three of us all let out a deep sigh.
The recent incident... Are you talking about when you guys were investigating the haunted castle?
It wasn't really an investigation, we just got lost and then got attacked.
And it turned out to all be an illusion.
N-Not only was I lost and alone, but I was scared to death! I'm not going through something like that again!
Yes, yes. You sound like a broken record.
That's what it was? In other words, a failed mission?
Not really. The haunted castle is gone, the demons have been defeated, and there were no casualties.
What was the cause? Did you find out?
Well then that's a failure, isn't it?
It's fine. We went there and returned safely.
Wow, setting the bar low. That's the Fuma I know.
We were late, but despite arguing about various stuff in the hallway, we got lost in the class-rearrangement hustle and bustle and safely made it into the classroom.
After waiting restlessly in my new seat for a while, Sakura-sensei entered.
My bad, my bad~ I'm a bit late. It's been a busy morning. Oh, looks like everyone is here, good, good.
As I'm sure you all know by now, the classes have been rearranged and I'm the temporary homeroom teacher for this class!
Well, to prepare for any more troublesome events like that, we have placed combat-ready Taimanin in each classroom.
And with that, let's all look forward to working together. Oh, my name is Igawa Sakura... but you all know that, right? Nahahaha♪
The atmosphere in the classroom was lightened by Sakura-sensei being her usual self.
Alright, I'd like to get started with homeroom stuff right away, but before that...
This morning, on top of being late, some delightful... no, outrageous... students forced their way through the school gate and knocked out the student council's gate attendants.

When I call your name, please stand up.
Fuma-kun, Hebiko-chan, Shikanosuke-kun.
Oh, and Yukikaze-chan.
But it didn't seem like we'd be able to talk our way out of it anyway.
You~guys~... did you really think you wouldn't get caught doing that?
Looks like you really wanted to go on a rampage, so I'll prepare an opponent for you. Alrighty, all four of you, get on out, to the sports field.
That's weird. How did they find out?
Uwuwuwuh, my bad feeling already came true...
We were waiting on the sports field for the appearance of "something" that Sakura-sensei had prepared.
What might it be...? I had a rough idea though.
Why does it seem like you're enjoying this...
I'm not happy about it though.
Appearing with a roar were the Animal Taimanin that Sakura-sensei took care of: Shinobi Snakes and Shinobi Bears.
They were the same animals that had gone savage because of the haunted castle's illusion and attacked us.
They were following Sakura-sensei's orders now, but the fact that they were baring their fangs at us remained the same.
Snake-chan, Bear-chan, those four are pretty tough. Make sure to not hold back!
Yukikaze-chan, you can't kill them. If you do, I'll be very angry.
O~kay! Now, get ready for your punishment battle! Ready, and gooooooo!!
